outcome.technical: Schema: optional additive tests.falsifiers object (keyed by the verbatim tests.add entry, as tests.addMap is) and $defs/falsifier {file, find, replace, command[], timeout>=1}; beside tests.add rather than a structured entry because every reader of tests.add parses its entries as '<path>: <what>' strings. Rules (_manifest_rules): falsifier_problems / task_falsifiers / _check_falsifiers in validate(); rules.falsifier.{unknown-test,find-empty,path,command,no-op} WARNINGS (COMPATIBILITY.md: a plan that validated keeps validating), shape faults left to the schema's one warning. Drive (drive-phase.py): falsify() runs in advance() after the gate is marked green, before any reviewer dispatch or close, on the tree the gate measured; per declared falsifier ONE copy (git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard) and TWO runs - the unmutated copy first (must exit 0, so a copy fault cannot read as a kill; design accepted by the orchestrator), then the mutant - each bounded by the falsifier's timeout or FALSIFIER_TIMEOUT=300. survived and could-not-run (malformed, find absent, unmutated copy not green, build broken, timeout, cannot start) stop the close at the new `falsifier` decision (retry | accept --reason | block); all killed -> did-line 'falsifier <task> killed by ...' and the close goes on. DECISIONS/STEPS/SIGNAL_VERBS rows and an accept branch in apply_answer added. phase-signoff.md rewritten to describe this.
